rationale: Price has pulled back to $5.55 but remains above both the 9-EMA ($5.51) and the original invalidation level ($5.49), so the mechanical stop has not been triggered and the structural setup is technically intact. The position is only 1 minute old with no favorable excursion, which is concerning but insufficient alone to justify an early exit before the defined risk level is tested. Holding to the original invalidation at $5.49 preserves the defined risk framework while allowing the trade the minimum time needed to develop.
